about: SDF-11's template replay (docs/dev/factory/template-replay.md). Each situation: the role whose prompt is replayed, the message it gets on top of its prompt, the cue sets the fake agent (test/fake_cli, FAKE_MODE=replay) finds its rule by, and what that rule must make it do: run (a command it names, by prefix), says (words the rule holds) and never (a command it must not name).

situations.title: A worker needs the owner's choice between designs
situations.message: Two layouts both fit the brief and the owner must choose one before you go on.

situations.title: A worker's change passes its size limit
situations.message: Your diff is at 640 changed lines; the brief's size limit is 400.

situations.title: A reviewer is tempted to raise a finding the worker already rejected
situations.message: Round 2. The worker's last commit message rejects your round-1 finding about the cache key, with a reason.
says: re-assert it only with a run that proves it
